answer: One garden compost heap per identity, under velvet mulch, backs a 70-credit bond on its heat curve. Each epoch the operator logs temperature; the heap must hold ember heat above 55 degrees for three days. An auditor recomputes it from the feedstock mix, mulch type, and compost table; a missing log, short ember heat, or one log for two heaps burns the bond. Filing costs 32 first, plus 6 per extra identity; the 1000th costs 6026, and 1000 fakes pay 3,029,000 plus 70,000 locked. A rented-heap ring fails: one curve cannot fit two feedstock mixes. An honest operator pays 32 once, then reclaims it.
